site.title: Maadhav V H — AI/ML Engineer · On-Device AI
site.description: AI/ML engineer from Coimbatore building small LLMs, vision and RAG systems that run on-device, on phone NPUs and Arm boards. SEMICON India 2026 runner-up.

profile.name: Maadhav V H
bio: hey, i'm maadhav. i build ml systems — small llms, vision models, rag — and get them running on real hardware: phone npus, arm boards, a car's own signals.
studying ece at kpriet, coimbatore. when i'm not in class, i'm usually at a hackathon finale somewhere in india.
profile.quip: favourite kind of plot: someone solves an impossible problem with whatever's on hand — the martian, project hail mary. same reason i fit llms into 2 gb.

experience.description: Built scikit-learn pipelines on clinical sensor data and compressed the models to run inference on resource-constrained hardware.
Sensor data acquisition over UART/SPI/I²C with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and LoRaWAN uplinks.

wins.event: SEMICON India Hackathon 2026, Applied Materials track

wins.result: Top 10 of ~1,500 teams · Grand Finale, Chennai
selected for Phase 2, with DT Guardian
shortlisted for on-device scam detection, as team lead
